title: Yellowed Crisp Uruguayan Biscuit Roast
description: A roasted Uruguayan dish featuring crispy digestive biscuits in a miso marinade, tailored to ayurvedic tamasic principles for a cozy meal. This dish is perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together miso paste, olive oil, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper to make the marinade.
Add the digestive biscuits to the marinade and toss until the biscuits are evenly coated.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and arrange the marinated biscuits in a single layer.
Roast the biscuits in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until they are crispy and golden brown.
Remove the biscuits from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley.
Let the biscuits cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the Yellowed Crisp Uruguayan Biscuit Roast warm, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
